purpose: Exhaust every retained same-game corner-count monotone, additive-partition, and parity payoff identity before viewing any package price.

distinctness.prior_soccer_graphs: Prior soccer graphs test goals, match results, exact scores, scorers, and half results; they do not test corner-count markets.
distinctness.this_graph: This graph covers full, first-half, second-half, and team corner ladders; exact additivity of the two halves and two teams into the full-game total; and parity implied by adjacent full-total thresholds.
distinctness.price_blind_freeze: Corner market labels and complete rules were inspected to define integer payoff identities. No corner package price sum was inspected before this contract was frozen.

retained_source.population_scope: Every 23-market total-corners event in the immutable 100-event response.

relation_contracts.legs: YES Over lower threshold plus YES Under higher threshold
YES Under each component threshold plus YES full Over threshold
YES Over each component threshold plus YES full Under threshold
YES Under lower threshold plus YES Over adjacent higher threshold plus YES implied parity

rule_contract.full_partition: first-half plus second-half corner counts and each team's corner count sum exactly to the full first-90-minutes-plus-stoppage-time count
rule_contract.source: official governing-body or organizer statistics, then the same Flashscore, Sofascore, and credible-reporting fallback chain
rule_contract.no_data_fallback: every tested leg resolves 50-50 after 48 hours without acceptable data

price_contract.missing_side_specific_price: fail closed and do not substitute outcomePrices

stopping_rules.zero_strict_candidates: Terminalize this retained population without any venue request.
stopping_rules.one_or_more_strict_candidates: Retain and deterministically rank all strict rows. Because every retained match has ended, make no request; preregister one future distinct active equivalent relation before exact book access.
